reason: I'd let it try the free 30, but with receipts landing in three or four groups every day that's gone in a few days, and then I'm at $35 or even $79 a month just to sort receipts. That's another subscription I'd question every month, so I'd stop at the free part.
objection: Thirty documents isn't enough for me to know if it saves us real time before I have to pay, and at our volume the cheap $19 plan won't cover a month, so the real price is $35 to $79.
would_change_my_mind: A full free month on all my groups, then one flat price under $20 that covers what a café actually sends.
